## Changes Made

### `src/slugkit/unique.py` (new file)
Implements `unique_slug(text, existing)`:
1. Computes `base = slugify(text)` — reusing the existing function
2. Returns `base` if not in `existing`
3. Otherwise tries suffixes `~2`, `~3`, `~4`, … until a free slug is found
4. When adding a suffix, trims the base so the total length stays within `SLUG_MAX`, and strips any trailing `~` from the trimmed base before appending the suffix

### `src/slugkit/__init__.py` (updated)
Added `from slugkit.unique import unique_slug` and exported it in `__all__`.

### `tests/test_unique.py` (new file)
Covers all spec rules:
- Base not in existing → returns base as-is
- Base taken → returns base + `~2`
- Multiple suffixes skipped → returns next free one
- `existing` set is never modified
- Result length ≤ `SLUG_MAX` even with long bases
- No trailing `~` before the suffix after trimming
- `EMPTY_SLUG` (`n~a`) works as a base and gets suffixed correctly (`n~a~2`, `n~a~3`)","time":{"start":1794760272033,"end":1794760277784}}}
